title: Comparing choices
summary: Use the English meaning and Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase.

s01.sentenceGloss: This box is big, but the other is bigger.

s02.sentenceGloss: This bag is small, but the other is even smaller.

s03.sentenceGloss: It costs the least of all; it is the cheapest.

s04.sentenceGloss: This bicycle costs more; it is more expensive.

s05.sentenceGloss: It is better to repair the bicycle than to throw it away.
s05.note: Än introduces the second part of a comparison.

s06.sentenceGloss: All the suggestions are good, but this one is best.

s07.sentenceGloss: The old engine works worse than the new one.

s08.sentenceGloss: I bring a bag in order to avoid buying a new one.
